caption: The drawing features a large stylized tulip-like flower in the center, composed of symmetrical flame-shaped petals in red, gold, and blue. The flower has an elongated blue stem with blue and red curving leaves and small red decorative offshoots, all growing out of a striped, cup-shaped base that is white with blue vertical stripes and red handles on each side. The background is beige. Surrounding the central flower are eight smaller, evenly spaced decorative motifs. Four of these motifs (placed partially above and below the central axis and to the sides of the flower) each contain a red ring of four petal-like shapes, with blue dots and a blue central cross. The other two motifs, placed near the bottom left and right, are circular arrangements of small red dots with a central yellow circle, each containing a six-pointed blue star. The style is geometric and symmetrical, predominantly colored in red, blue, and yellow on an unadorned beige background.
title: Drawing for Plate 9: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
